name: EngineerAgent
description: Reads confirmed RCA from Detective Agent. Scores healing branches using utility formula: impact * criticality * (1-risk) * reversibility. Builds TMF921 remediation intent. Publishes engineer.ready for Executor Agent.

skills.name: Healing Branch Utility Scoring
skills.description: Scores each healing branch using utility formula: Utility = impact * criticality * (1 - risk) * reversibility. Ranks branches by utility score (highest first). Fetches business metadata per entity from BigQuery or structural fallback.
examples: Compute utility for antenna tilt rollback branch
Compute utility for HSS session clear branch
Rank branches by utility score descending

skills.name: TMF921 Remediation Intent Builder
skills.description: Builds TMF921-compliant remediation intent with recovery target expressions, action commands (ANTENNA_TILT_ADJUST, HSS_SESSION_CLEAR, TRANSPORT_FAILOVER), and parameter bounds from remediation configuration.
examples: Build antenna tilt rollback command with target_degrees
Build HSS session clear command with max_clear
Build transport failover command with backup_path

skills.name: Detective RCA Parsing
skills.description: Parses detective.rca.confirmed event from Detective Agent. Extracts root_cause, domain, affected_entities, causal_parameters, recovery_targets, risk_score, reversibility_score, and KPI delta percentage.
